title: Codex executor output schema (v3.5.0+)
description: Structured JSON that codex CLI must return when invoked as the Execute-phase implementer via `codex exec --output-schema`. pev-external-executor skill parses this; the Claude executor agent then reads `git diff` and authors execute.log / DRY self-review / judgment trace itself (= wrapper model). OpenAI structured outputs strict 仕様に従い、 全 properties が required (optional は型に null を含めて表現)、 additionalProperties: false、 oneOf/anyOf 不使用。

status.description: implemented = codex edited files per the brief; ambiguity_stop = codex hit an unresolvable ambiguity and edited NO files; no_change = brief required no edit

summary.description: Short prose summary of what was implemented (or why it stopped), <= 500 chars

files_changed.description: Files codex created / modified / deleted. Empty array when status is ambiguity_stop or no_change.

description.description: One-line description of the change, <= 120 chars

ambiguity_detected.description: true when codex encountered an ambiguity it could not resolve from the brief + cwd context. When true, codex must NOT edit files and must set status=ambiguity_stop.

ambiguity_note.description: When ambiguity_detected is true, the questions / options the Claude executor should surface as .pev-artifacts/clarification.md; null otherwise

commit_message.description: Proposed conventional-commit message for the change; null when no_change / ambiguity_stop. The Claude executor may refine it in execute.log.

model.description: Codex internal model identifier if exposed (e.g., 'gpt-5.3-codex'); null when not exposed

notes.description: Optional free-form notes for the Claude executor (assumptions made, follow-ups), <= 500 chars; null when none
